page: Amazon Web Services trn3.48xlarge is a specialized accelerator instance architected for large-scale machine learning training and deep learning inference workloads. Running on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, the instance pairs an x86_64 host system with proprietary Annapurna hardware accelerators. The host configuration features a dedicated 96-core, 192-thread Intel processor operating at 2.4 GHz, backed by 2048.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 10.67 GB of RAM per physical core.

The core compute capability is delivered by 16 Annapurna Trainium3 accelerators offering an aggregate accelerator memory of 2304 GB. To sustain high-throughput data ingestion, model parallelism, and multi-node training clusters, the instance features an expansive 3200 Gbps baseline network bandwidth alongside 7600 GB of integrated NVMe SSD local storage for low-latency checkpointing and training data staging.

Given its specialized accelerator silicon, the platform represents a purpose-built alternative to standard general-purpose GPU architectures. The combination of dense accelerator VRAM, massive cluster-grade interconnect speeds, and large local NVMe scratch space positions the trn3.48xlarge primarily for foundation model training, large language model fine-tuning, and ultra-high-throughput distributed deep learning workloads.
